purpose: Draft falsification and test ledger. No entry is a completed preregistration until its operational specification and documented pre-exposure chronology are frozen. Formal anchors name scoped mathematics, not experimental validation.

entries.claim: alpha has no time argument and cannot drift; a continuous history of values in {1/(128 + d^2) : d in N} is constant.
entries.comparator: nuclear-clock alpha-drift bounds (e.g. Th-229, Yb+/Sr comparisons)
entries.kill_condition: A confirmed, calibrated time variation of alpha.
entries.formal_scope: Continuity plus membership in the discrete structural value set implies constancy; the measured coupling and residual/running correction are not identified by this theorem.

entries.claim: The proposed closure mechanism would avoid requiring a Peccei-Quinn axion to cancel physical theta, if the winding-to-QCD bridge is established.
entries.kill_condition: A failure of the frozen winding-to-physical-theta bridge would reject that mechanism. Axion detection rejects only a separately specified axion-absence hypothesis; it does not alone refute that an axion is unnecessary.
entries.formal_scope: A defined CP-odd winding is zero on a ZFA closure; this neither constructs physical QCD theta nor proves that axions cannot exist.

entries.claim: The antiparticle is the time-mirror: same length (mass proxy), opposite charge and opposite junction baryon number.
entries.comparator: BASE proton/antiproton mass and charge-to-mass comparisons
entries.kill_condition: A confirmed CPT-violating mass or charge-to-mass difference.
entries.formal_scope: Conjugate-and-reverse preserves word length and negates a defined charge count; length-to-mass and experimental charge maps remain open.

entries.claim: The nu1-only Majorana refinement predicts m_betabeta approximately 0.25 meV.
entries.kill_condition: The published defeater is a 0nubb signal at the LEGEND-1000/nEXO reach of approximately 10 meV, inconsistent with the QLF window; the exact window logic is to be finalized with the collaboration.
entries.formal_scope: The assigned up/down word is self-conjugate. No quantitative effective mass or decay-rate window follows from this anchor.

entries.claim: QRNG streams match the ZFA-closure null.
entries.kill_condition: A predeclared, calibrated deviation from the closure null.
entries.formal_scope: No formal anchor is claimed; a quantitative null distribution and decision rule remain to be specified.
No formal anchor is claimed; a calibrated physical signal model and rejection rule remain to be specified.
